members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: items
members.doc: The full option set, filtered as the user types by a case- and accent-insensitive contains match on each item's text. Pass every option rather than a pre-filtered list.

members.name: value
members.doc: The text in the input, when the caller controls it. When the selected id is also controlled, choosing an option does not update the text: the application sets it, usually to the option's label.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The text in the input at first, when the field controls itself.

members.name: selectedId
members.doc: The id of the selected item, when the caller controls the selection. A controlled field with no selection passes null; an empty string is not an id and throws. A controlled selectedId stays until the application changes it.

members.name: defaultSelectedId
members.doc: The id of the item selected at first, when the field controls its selection. An empty string is not an id and throws.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The option list takes it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its text stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed, and no option can be chosen.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits the selected item's id, not the item's `value`, or an empty value when nothing is selected.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: An example value shown while the field is empty. It does not name the field.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the text each time it changes, including when choosing an option sets it to the option's label.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called with the chosen item, or with no item when the selection clears. Emptying the input clears the selection.
